messages.subject: regionCounts after uniting samples
parts:
Hello,

Thank you for the excellent tool. My DRM analysis (on region level) is full of calls within sites, where some of the samples have significantly more bases called for methylation. I would like to get rid of these spurious calls be running unite() before regionCounts(). Is it possible to obtain methylRawList object from MethylBase object?

br,
tommi

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: regionCounts after uniting samples
parts:
The easiest way would be to filter methylRaw objects based on the "id" column of the methylBase object from base-pair resolution objects.

  You will probably have to create a new methyRawList object  that contains the bases that occurs in all samples. Then you can run unite() on that new methylRawList object.

here is how to create a methylRawList object from a list of methylRaw objects:

myobj=new("methylRawList",outList,treatment=treatment)

outList is a list of methyRaw objects
treatment is the treatment vector you give when you are reading in the files. The order of treatment vector should correspond to the order of samples in the outList.



Best,
Altuna
